name: Uttik AI Answer Engine
author: honeytech

sections.description:
The Uttik AI Answer Engine plugin is a powerful tool for adding a dynamic and SEO-friendly FAQ section to your website. It uses the Uttik API to deliver an AI-powered answer engine, providing users with instant answers to their questions. The plugin automatically generates Schema.org FAQPage structured data, which can help improve your site’s visibility in search results.

Key Features:
* AI Answer Engine Optimization (AEO): Enhance your site’s SEO with AI-powered answers.
* Schema.org Integration: Automatically generates FAQPage structured data to improve search engine visibility.
* Customizable Widget: A beautiful and responsive FAQ widget that can be easily customized to match your site’s design.
* Floating Support Button: Includes a floating support button to provide users with easy access to the FAQ widget.
* SEO-Optimized Single FAQ Pages: Generates individual, SEO-friendly pages for each FAQ.

To get started, you’ll need an Uttik Organization ID, which you can obtain from https://uttik.com.

External Services

This plugin connects to the following third-party services:

  • Uttik API:

    • Service: The Uttik API is used to fetch and display the FAQs in the widget, provide AI-powered answers, and manage organization settings.
    • Data Sent: Your Uttik Organization ID and API key are sent with each request to authenticate and retrieve your FAQ data. When a user interacts with the widget (e.g., asks a question), that query is sent to the Uttik API to get an answer.
    • Terms of Service: https://uttik.com/terms-of-service
    • Privacy Policy: https://uttik.com/privacy-policy

  • Google:

    • Service: The plugin pings Google’s sitemap service to notify it of updates to your FAQ sitemap. This helps Google discover and index your FAQ pages more quickly.
    • Data Sent: The URL of your FAQ sitemap is sent to Google.
    • Terms of Service: https://policies.google.com/terms
    • Privacy Policy: https://policies.google.com/privacy

  • Bing:

    • Service: The plugin pings Bing’s sitemap service to notify it of updates to your FAQ sitemap. This helps Bing discover and index your FAQ pages more quickly.
    • Data Sent: The URL of your FAQ sitemap is sent to Bing.
    • Terms of Service: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/servicesagreement/
    • Privacy Policy: https://privacy.microsoft.com/en-us/privacystatement
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/uttik-answer-engine directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to the Settings > Uttik AI FAQ screen to configure the plugin with your Uttik Organization ID.
  4. Add the [uttik_faq_widget] shortcode to any page or post to display the FAQ widget.
sections.changelog:
1.0.11

  • Addressed all feedback from the WordPress plugin review team.
  • Correctly enqueued scripts and styles using wp_enqueue_scripts and wp_enqueue_style.
  • Added documentation for all external services used by the plugin.
  • Fixed file and directory location issues by using plugin_dir_path and plugin_dir_url.
  • Corrected the text domain to match the plugin slug (uttik-answer-engine).
  • Ensured all echoed variables are properly escaped.
  • Prevented direct file access to all PHP files.
  • Renamed the main plugin file and folder to match the plugin slug.

1.0.10

  • Security fixes for WordPress repository compliance.
  • Fixed variable prefixing and output escaping issues.
  • Improved sitemap generation.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
